title: Installed update throws before saving
reproduction: Start Alaska; offer a waiting worker; pause; tap UPDATE READY.
expected: Pause, save and activate only after a successful save.
actual: TypeError: session.pause is not a function; no activation.
root_cause: QuestAdventure registered only isActive and suspendViewport, omitting pause/save required by pwa241.js.
repair_status: FIXED in PR; actual Alaska update and quota regressions added.

title: Play label hides automatic resume
actual: Play Tahoe loads an existing save without explaining this.
root_cause: One fixed label used for both new and existing saves.
repair_status: FIXED: Start Tahoe / Continue Tahoe plus checkpoint explanation.

title: Visible objective omits exit direction
reproduction: Defeat Queen; stand still in landscape.
expected: Visible objective directs right to Alaska portal.
actual: Celebration replaces objective; directional detail is hidden by compact CSS.
root_cause: Direction existed only in the hidden objective detail span.
repair_status: FIXED: visible title says head right to Alaska portal.

title: Inactive gameplay chrome looks actionable
actual: HUD, touch attacks and pause appear before their input handlers are active; Share overlaps top chrome.
root_cause: Canvas-based worlds kept gameplay UI visible behind opening.
repair_status: FIXED: gameplay chrome hidden until opening closes; layout reservations preserved.

title: Final card instruction points to wrong section
reproduction: Read Hollywood objective; inspect last card coordinates.
expected: Tell player final card is on LA approach.
actual: Says recover final card in studio district; final card is x7580 in LA.
repair_status: FIXED copy; geometry and collectible indices unchanged.

title: Small action/phase text
expected: Readable labels while keeping 44px minimum targets.
actual: Touch labels and boss sublabels were 9px.
repair_status: FIXED to 10px; existing layout/touch regression coverage retained.

title: Legacy saves can infer Court completion
reproduction: Load Queen-active/defeated legacy save without Court victory record.
expected: Preserve old progress and expose missing encounter safely.
actual: courtDefeated inferred from Queen state; genuine victory not proven.
root_cause: Grandfathering predates current separate Court victory record.
repair_status: EXISTING MITIGATION retained: Complete / Replay Court; current save regression passes. New boss-order migration needs approval.

title: Card intersects one-way platform height
reproduction: Stand on platform x2560–2800 at y520; card begins y520.
actual: Card can be collected from underneath, not from standing on its top edge.
repair_status: OPEN: reachable in normal route; geometry adjustment deferred for review.

title: Detailed heroes versus procedural enemies
reproduction: Compare current heroes, judges and beetles.
actual: Approved detailed sprites coexist with simpler procedural/vector scenery and enemies.
root_cause: Different rendering pipelines and artwork generations.
repair_status: DEFERRED to supplied artwork integration; no asset replacement authorized now.

title: Small HUD text needs physical review
actual: Automated bounds pass; physical readability not established.
root_cause: HUD width budget and no physical device session.
repair_status: OPEN device review; no speculative HUD expansion.

title: Dead summoned beetles retained
reproduction: Keep fighting minions while Queen remains alive.
expected: Bound retained data over long sessions.
actual: Live enemies capped, but dead records accumulate; loader truncates saved list at 240.
root_cause: Append-only spawned list; no demonstrated real-session crash.
repair_status: OPEN stress-test risk; no proven memory leak or unsafe pruning repair claimed.

title: Approved order and 9-judge final differ from live
reproduction: Compare current route with new brief.
expected: Future mid-level Queen then final Court 1/3/9.
actual: Live Court 1/3/5 then Queen, both at City Hall.
root_cause: Current save/finale and arena geometry encode previous order.
repair_status: DOCUMENTED APPROVAL GATE: do not move encounters in this PR.

title: Toxic Bloom is design only
reproduction: Trace active Tahoe targets, boss object and water renderer.
expected: Future contaminated lake, algae/bubbles and blue restoration.
actual: No Toxic Bloom entity or contamination encounter; lake rendered blue.
repair_status: NOT IMPLEMENTED; separate approval and art required.

reproduction: Trace world sections, targets, hazards and checkpoints.
actual: Relays and thin ice exist; pipeline encounter, valves and flood simulation do not.
repair_status: NOT IMPLEMENTED; do not describe relays as pipeline valves.

actual: Current section is HOLLYWOOD studio district; no separately named West Hollywood geometry.
root_cause: Established five-section route differs from proposed destination list.
repair_status: DOCUMENTED; no invented or renamed playable area.

reproduction: Open title/pause world selector as a fresh player.
expected: Owner decision: free selection or sequential unlocking.
actual: All three implemented worlds are directly linked; future worlds have no link.

repair_status: DESIGN DECISION requested for future phase; existing access preserved.

expected: Wildlife policy confirmed before new enemy artwork.
actual: No wolves/polar bears are enemies; two owls are currently hostile.

expected: Clear warning or explicit confirmation before replacing a world save.
actual: Established handlers reset that world immediately.
